'''BV4.1''' is a retired<ref>{{Cite web| title=Methods - Seasonal adjustment |access-date=2026-03-06 |website=German Federal Statistical Office |url=https://www.destatis.de/EN/Methods/Seasonal-adjustment/_node.html}}</ref> [[application software]] tool for [[Decomposing of time series|decomposing]] and [[seasonal adjustment|seasonally adjusting]] monthly or quarterly economic [[time series]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Software for time series analyses according to the BV4.1 method |url=https://www.destatis.de/EN/Methods/Seasonal-adjustment/mathematical-statistical-method.html |access-date=2024-01-05 |website=German Federal Statistical Office |language=en}}</ref> by version 4.1 of the [[Berlin procedure]] developed by the [[Federal Statistical Office of Germany]]. The software is released as [[freeware]] for non-commercial purposes.

==Features==
The essential features of the BV4.1 software are:

* System requirements: Windows PC ([[Windows NT 4.0]] / [[Windows 98]] up to [[Windows XP]]).
* Support of the file formats [[Microsoft Excel]], [[Microsoft Access]], [[Microsoft SQL Server|SQL Server]] and [[Comma-separated values|CSV]].
* User-friendly graphical user interface.
* Analyses of monthly and quarterly time series.
* Possibility of mass production of time series decompositions and seasonal adjustments.
* Various possibilities of graphic evaluations of analysis results.
* Possibility to execute "successive analyses": analyses where the analysis spans are extended gradually by one additional period. This option is useful for examining such revisions of analysis results originating from the BV4.1 procedure itself.
